subject: Raphinha is sent off late as Brazil lose 3-2 to Japan
title: Captain and coach see red, Brazil lose

lines.vo: Brazil's captain and coach both saw red. Brazil lost anyway.
lines.footage: Brazil vs Japan 3-2 highlights, Singapore friendly

lines.vo: Japan won three-two in Singapore, with a ninety-first-minute winner.
lines.footage: Japan late winner Brazil friendly, goal celebration

lines.vo: Raphinha, the captain, had just promised to give his best for Brazil.
Then he protested the Japan goal, and got a red card. Best effort, wrong department.
lines.footage: Raphinha protest and red card, referee shows card

lines.vo: Carlo Ancelotti was sent off too, for the same protest.
Same goal, same protest, same card. Brazil do love a team effort.
lines.footage: Ancelotti and Raphinha protest, referee and fourth official

lines.vo: Ancelotti then served a one-match touchline ban against Singapore.
Raphinha was suspended too, so Bruno Guimaraes took the armband. Brazil won seven-nil.
Lose with the captain and the coach there, win seven-nil without them. Make of that what you will.
lines.card: Make of that what you will
lines.footage: Brazil celebration after 7-0 win, team huddle

inserts.story: Setup: a paper cut-out Raphinha raises his right hand and solemnly swears to give his best. Gag: a cut-out referee slides a red card into his palm like a prize. Twist: he pins it on his chest like a medal, and the referee adds a gold star sticker.
inserts.characters: Generic cut-out referee; caricature of Raphinha as captain

inserts.story: Setup: a cut-out Ancelotti and a cut-out Raphinha protest in perfect sync, arms flapping like one puppet. Gag: two red cards pop up at the same time and they march off down one tunnel, in step. Twist: they get stuck in the doorway together because their cardboard shoulders are too wide.
inserts.characters: Generic cut-out referee and fourth official; caricatures of Carlo Ancelotti and Raphinha

inserts.story: Setup: a cardboard scoreboard flips to 7-0 and a cut-out Bruno Guimaraes lifts the armband. Gag: far up in the cut-out stands, a cut-out captain and a cut-out coach eat popcorn and clap politely. Twist: a cardboard steward quietly hangs a sign on their two seats: 'Please stay there'.
inserts.characters: Generic cut-out steward and crowd; caricatures of Bruno Guimaraes, Raphinha and Carlo Ancelotti

facts_used: Brazil, captained by Raphinha, lost 3-2 to Japan in a friendly in Singapore; Japan had a 91st-minute winner (ev0134)
Raphinha played 71 minutes before being sent off late; sending-off came after he said he would give his best for Brazil (ev0134)
Ancelotti and Raphinha were both sent off late after protesting the Japan goal; Ancelotti has a one-match touchline ban against Singapore (ev0134)
Bruno Guimaraes took the armband; Raphinha suspended for Brazil's 7-0 win over Singapore on 17 November (ev0134)
notes: Comic, 3 inserts (zero-based after_line). Jokes rest on the sending-off, the suspension and the 7-0 result only. No health, injury or personal jokes. Insert characters are generic cut-outs and caricatures, no logos. The '71 minutes' detail from ev0134 is not used because it conflicts with a late red card. Data note: ESPN 'injury-time winner' conflicts with FC Barcelona diary's 91st-minute winner; the script uses 91st minute.
